title: Voyager golden record carrying the Navajo Night Chant
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Voyager golden record carrying the Navajo Night Chant, about 1977 at Voyager 1 and 2, interstellar space, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Each spacecraft carried what was known as a golden record containing the sights and sounds of planet Earth.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of the two Voyager spacecraft launched in 1977, which are now out in interstellar space. He says each one carried a golden record holding the sights and sounds of planet Earth, and the story notes that among them was the Navajo Night Chant, a ceremonial song of the Navajo people. It is told as a message from Earth meant for anyone out there who might one day find it.
